status: Received positioning refinement applied to visual proposals

variants.name: A-airy-split
variants.prompt:
Edit the supplied AdaptOps landing page image with exactly TWO COPY GROUP changes. Preserve the received white/navy/petrol/mint art direction, logo, page dimensions, all main layout positions, generous whitespace, typography style, hero headline, navigation, product illustration, benefit row, CTA buttons and all remaining text. This is a precise copy refinement of an approved design, not a new redesign. All text in English, sharp and spelled correctly.

CHANGE 1, HERO SUBHEADING: replace the paragraph beginning "An agent that connects market changes..." with exactly:
"An agent that knows your business, works across your tools and uses market intelligence to coordinate a response and execute the actions you approve."
Keep it in the existing hero subheading area, naturally wrapped, readable at the same body type size. Make the minimum local vertical spacing adjustment if needed, without shifting the overall page composition. The message must visibly include knowing the business, working across its tools, market intelligence, coordinating a response and execution after user approval.

CHANGE 2, AUDIENCE BLOCK: replace the entire narrow audience wording "Built for operations and procurement leaders in multi-site timber and materials businesses." with exactly:
"Built for teams managing inventory, supply and customer commitments."
Then add a smaller supporting line in that same block:
"Across operations, procurement, sales and finance."
Do not repeat "Built for" twice if the original block has a small uppercase BUILT FOR label: remove that redundant small label or make the single full sentence sufficient. Keep this block airy, aligned and clearly readable. It must broaden the product to all teams concerned with inventory, supply and customer commitments, across industries. Do not add industry-specific wording here.

Everything else stays visually unchanged. In particular keep "Adapt as fast as your market changes.", "Your next response is ready", "Review & approve", the business loop and all three customer outcomes. No new sections, badges, data/test/demo claims, metrics, logos, photographs or decorations.
